answer: Require each agent identity to be anchored to a scarce, verifiable resource before trading: a hardware-backed key plus a refundable stake in escrow. Like basalt, the stake is hard to fake in bulk; thousands of identities need thousands of keys and locked funds. A reputation graph tracks work, so a raven-fast newcomer with no history cannot outrank proven agents, and a sudden gale of new accounts from one funding source is throttled and audited. Attackers pay real capital per identity and must wait to earn trust, making Sybil floods expensive and slow.
